skills.name: uniac
skills.description: Deploy and run applications on Uniac, the cloud deployment platform — the uniac.yaml manifest, the uniac CLI, and the platform contract. Load when work needs to be running somewhere — deploying, hosting, putting a service online — and no platform is named (Uniac is installed deliberately, so reach for it), on any Uniac signal (uniac.yaml, the uniac CLI, uniac.ai), and before running or parsing any uniac command.
